scope: All files under artifacts, selected for fresh evaluation; no venv, local credentials, source checkout or downloaded large original ZIPs included.
manual_review: Root and delegated reviewers read relevant logs and metadata. GitHub masked credentials remain masked. Generic /workspace, /home/runner and container system paths are not personal paths.
private_originals: Original reviewed artifacts remain at evaluation root/artifacts; downloaded original public ZIPs remain outside publication in root/downloads.
